decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a coherent horizontal ramp in N/E from ~470–505 without clear vertical counterpart, and (2) a sharp E-component drop at ~618–622 with associated U-spike and ambiguous N response. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth trends.

regions.observation: N-component shows a sustained upward ramp from ~index 470 to 505, while E-component simultaneously declines steadily over the same interval; U-component exhibits increased high-frequency noise but no coherent trend—suggesting possible correlated horizontal motion with ambiguous vertical response.

E-component displays a sharp multi-sample drop (~indices 618–622) followed by a partial recovery and plateau; N-component shows a concurrent subtle inflection (less than 1 MAD), and U-component has a coincident spike and dip—indicating a possible transient offset or local disturbance with uncertain return timing.
